category: inference gateway, free plan with free models only

free_tier.stated: Free plan at $0 per month with $0 in monthly credits: access to the models marked FREE in the catalog only, at standard rate limits; a third-party plan table reads 50 RPM / 500K TPM
free_tier.notes: the free model set rotates; the portal catalog page read on 2026-11-04 lists Reflection Beam 1.0 501B A23B, Crouton Alpha, StepFun Step 3.7 Flash and Upstage Solar Mini 4 as free; the true unit is a request and token rate with no volume cap, which no unit term names

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://inference-api.nousresearch.com/v1, stated in the first-party OpenAPI definition and API docs; Hermes Agent CLI logs in through OAuth. Routes: POST /chat/completions, POST /completions, GET /models.
chaining: free models only; paid models and API keys draw on prepaid credits

limits.value: 50 RPM / 500K TPM per a third-party plan table; unverified on the vendor page, which prints only 'standard rate limits' and no numbers; unverified: behind a sign-up
50 RPM, 500,000 TPM for the Free tier, stated in the first-party OpenAPI definition under API Key Rate Limits

identity_cost.detail: a Nous Portal account (email, Discord or wallet login); one first-hand third-party report states the Free plan is activated through a 0-yen payment screen that requires a credit card; another directory records no card requirement, so the card requirement is reported, not documented

reliability_note: the free model list rotates and one report found only 6 of 10 listed free models answering
confidence_note: Endpoint, routes, auth scheme and the Free 50 RPM / 500,000 TPM limit come from the first-party OpenAPI definition and API docs read on 2026-11-18; the host was probed live with an unkeyed GET /models that returned 200. Model access for a free account remains unverified: behind a sign-up.

interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible REST. POST /chat/completions and POST /completions for inference; GET /models for the public model list. Auth is an API key as a bearer token in the Authorization header (BearerAuth, HTTP bearer scheme).
notes: endpoint filled from first-party OpenAPI definition on 2026-11-18; the free tier uses the same host as paid tiers, distinguished by the 50 RPM / 500,000 TPM limit and FREE model tags. On 2026-11-18 two keyless POSTs to /v1/chat/completions returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge page, so the host answered and refused the request at the edge.
binding_note: the free tier is bounded by the 50 requests a minute and 500,000 tokens a minute limit, not by a credit balance
